rule: Stripe account details may be requested only when every non-payment gate scores at least 8 out of 10.

paymentRail.reason: Stripe account creation, credentials, sandbox events, live charges, and bank settlement remain intentionally absent.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Two no-sale offers now distinguish $1.99 monthly catalog access from $9.99 permanent fixed-collection ownership, preserve the free game, and list cancellation and exclusions plainly.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Recheck comprehension with external players before any price is called validated.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Guest-first passkey and optional email-link routes, browser UI, hashed sessions, SQLite restart persistence, and HTTP tests exist locally; hosted persistence and real-device proof do not.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Deploy a no-payment durable Captain Passport beta and pass the supported device matrix.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Hashed single-use recovery, rotation, old-session/passkey revocation, and replacement-device tests exist; no real-device or observed human comprehension evidence exists.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Complete concurrent redemption, lost-device, replacement-passkey, and human recovery drills.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Hashed sessions, player-facing device revocation, cookie-bound HTTP identity, and authenticated live-socket account binding pass local tests; deployed multi-device proof is absent.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Prove single-session and revoke-all behavior against deployed HTTP and WebSocket sessions.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Authenticated live deaths write one server-calculated XP award per life idempotency key into SQLite and restore into the Passport UI; hosted durability and operational recovery are absent.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Award each eligible authoritative life exactly once into the durable Captain Log.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Provider-neutral monthly and permanent products now derive access from an append-only SQLite log with duplicate protection, paid-through monotonicity, cancellation state, named reversals, Captain Log history, and cross-restart restoration. No provider, refund/dispute adapter, hosted database, or reconciliation drill exists.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Prove expiration, refund/dispute, backup/restore, reconciliation, and fresh-device display before connecting any payment provider.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Catalog tests and public copy prohibit paid XP, score, size, speed, boost, collision power, multipliers, zoom, radar, lives, rank, skips, and randomized odds.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Repeat protocol and collision audits on the exact payment candidate revision.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: The current no-account preview has truthful privacy copy; account retention, deletion, age handling, subscription terms, tax, refunds, and owner/legal approval are absent.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Complete the data inventory and obtain owner/legal review for account and child-directed commerce behavior.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: The game, Passport, session manager, entitlement summary, and free Captain Rooms launch UI have keyboard semantics, responsive layouts, reduced-motion coverage where applicable, and automated desktop/mobile checks; independent screen-reader and zoom/reflow audits remain.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Pass the complete keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, and error-recovery matrix.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Arena authority plus Passport HTTP, SQLite restart, account-bound progression, entitlement idempotency, and 10/20/30 room-capacity tests exist; database failure injection, backup/restore, and reconciliation services do not.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Meet predeclared account latency and error targets under burst, restart, and dependency failure.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: Requirements exist, but backup/restore, key rotation, migration rollback, support lookup, incident disable, and reconciliation drills have not been executed.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: A human other than the implementer must run and record every drill.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: The value is visible and interest can be measured with consent, but there is no predeclared external-player sample or willingness-to-pay result.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Observe external players and pass declared comprehension, desire, repeat-use, and price thresholds.

nonPaymentGates.evidence: No separate reviewer has reproduced the account, fairness, accessibility, recovery, operations, or financial-ledger evidence on one release revision.
nonPaymentGates.nextProof: Commission and record an independent reproduction after all underlying surfaces exist.
